steps.js: await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); document.querySelectorAll('details:not([open])').forEach(d=>{}); const vis=(e)=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=getComputedStyle(e); return r.width>1&&r.height>1&&s.visibility!=='hidden'&&s.display!=='none'&&r.top<innerHeight&&r.bottom>0;}; const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,a[href],[role=button],summary,[role=tab]')].filter(vis).filter(e=>!e.disabled); const small=[]; for(const e of els){ const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); const b=getComputedStyle(e,'::before'); let w=r.width,h=r.height; if(b.content!=='none'&&b.position==='absolute'){ const ins=['top','right','bottom','left'].map(k=>parseFloat(b[k])||0); w=Math.max(w,r.width-ins[1]-ins[3]); h=Math.max(h,r.height-ins[0]-ins[2]); } if(Math.min(w,h)<28) small.push((e.innerText||e.getAttribute('aria-label')||e.className).toString().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,14)+' '+Math.round(w)+'x'+Math.round(h)); } return {n:els.length, under28:small.length, sample:small.slice(0,8)};
